notes: HE0437-5439 — Included as follow_up: the paper names it among observed hyper-velocity stars and evaluates its possible LMC-IMBH ejection origin (T:p18-b3, T:p18-b4); the paper explicitly describes this hyper-velocity-star channel as ejection from the Galaxy (T:p2-b19). The paper also considers an LMC-IMBH origin and a blue-straggler alternative, but it does not newly claim the star as unbound.

HE0437-5439: The paper mentions HE0437-5439 (T:p18-b3, T:p18-b4) only as an example of a hyper-velocity star possibly ejected from an IMBH in the Large Magellanic Cloud. It reports no values for its position, distance, parallax, proper motion, radial velocity, galactocentric radius, Galactic rest-frame velocity, or bound/unbound probability. Therefore no eligible quantities are extracted.
